title: Tier-2 Paired Multi-Omic Perturbation Atlas — feasibility inventory
canonical_question: For how many (cell-context x perturbation x HLA-genotype) triples does MORE THAN ONE central-dogma modality co-exist? (the OBJECTIVES.md/docx-§5 go/no-go metric that decides whether H2->H3->H4 + the machinery-state bottleneck can be trained before wet-lab spend)
method: Reconciled the immune-llm registries (PAIRED_SAMPLE_INVENTORY, CAUSAL_PERTURBATION_IMMUNE_MANIFEST, PER_MODALITY_CORPORA, DATASET_MASTER_REGISTRY, CZI_TCELL manifest) against GROUND-TRUTH S3 holdings measured live 2026-09-13. Distinguishes SAME-DEPOSIT paired (>=2 modalities co-deposited on the same flask) from SAME-CONTEXT-CROSS-STUDY (join by HLA-typed cell line) from IDENTIFIED-BUT-NOT-HELD.

ground_truth_s3_holdings_2026_09_13.note: This is the decisive fact. The registries mix IDENTIFIED (verified accession, not downloaded) with HELD (bytes on S3). Only HELD deposits are trainable today; the rest are acquisition candidates.

deposits.PXD056426: HAP1, 11-gene antigen-processing-machinery KO (B2M/TAP1/TAP2/TAPBP/ERAP2/PDIA3/CALR/CANX/IRF2/GANAB/SPPL3) vs WT + MATCHED bulk PROTEOME in same deposit; genetic perturbation; one HLA background. H4 kill-gate PASSED here. => P+L same-deposit.
deposits.PXD020079: Glioblastoma HROG02/17/RA, CIITA stable OE + IFN-gamma arm; HLA-I AND HLA-II .raw + a 'Prot' proteome .raw file present in deposit => P+L same-deposit; HLA-II master-regulator.
deposits.PXD054491: A375 melanoma, ERAP1-KO vs WT; L only (spectronaut result + peptide list held).
deposits.PXD063219: HeLaM HLA-ABC-KO reconstituted B*44:02/B*44:05, TAPBPR KD + OE (+IFN-g); L only.
deposits.PXD060684: Breast (CAMA1 etc.), CDK4/6i (abemaciclib) vs control; L only.
deposits.PXD045265: ECN90 human beta-cell, IFN-alpha vs Basal (T1D-relevant); L only.
deposits.PXD041578: Calu-3, influenza + ATR002 (MEKi) vs DMSO; L only.
deposits.PXD037837: Primary donor cells, M. tuberculosis infection vs mock (donorC/D); L only; primary => no clean cell-line HLA join.
deposits.PXD055205: HCT116/HT29, hypoxia vs normoxia; L only.
deposits.PXD068488: MS RRMS patient B cells, HLA-DR immunopeptidome; L only; patient primary.
deposits.PXD022950: README only landed (no MS bytes) — NOT usable.

R_riboseq_HELD.acquisition_verdict: h2_riboseq_acquisition go_no_go = LIMITED: 0 processed general ribo-seq series with usable processed counts landed (<3). Many candidate series errored on upload (GSE142822, GSE224662 K562-KO, GSE313291 Jurkat, GSE254230 T-cell RPF). H2 corpus EXISTS publicly (~14.8k samples RDP) but is essentially NOT HELD.

T_perturbation_transcriptome_HELD.note: Tahoe-100M (95.6M cells, 50 lines x ~1100 compounds) + Replogle/Nadig + scPerturb subset + CZI T-cell Perturb-seq effect layers (~108 GB, GWCD4i.DE_stats/pseudobulk). H1 substrate is not the bottleneck. Every CCLE/Tahoe line is HLA-keyable via TCLP.

definition_1_same_deposit_paired_multimo.description: Triples where >=2 central-dogma modalities are co-deposited on the SAME flask AND the bytes are HELD on S3 today. This is the only tier that trains the cross-modal transformation directly.

triples.perturbation: genetic KO x11 machinery genes vs WT
triples.role: the H4 kill-gate PASS set; the machinery-state->presentation causal core
the only held class-II (CIITA) paired set

Weaker training evidence (cannot train the same-flask cross-modal delta) but usable for pretraining/baselines.

H1_perturbation_transcriptome.basis: Tahoe (50 lines) + Replogle + CZI primary T-cell atlas HELD; not the bottleneck. This is unpaired-per-modality and does not need the paired atlas.

H2_transcriptome_plus_riboseq.basis: 0 same-flask T+R triples HELD; 0 IFN-g/perturbation Ribo-seq on any HLA-typed line HELD. Ribo-seq corpus exists publicly (~14.8k RDP samples) but the H2 acquisition is LIMITED (0 usable processed series landed; matched-RNA RPF uploads FAILED for the T-cell/K562/Jurkat series). H2 as a MATCHED modality is effectively absent and is a Tier-2/acquisition ask. The 4-layer PXD013649 that would seed H2 is IDENTIFIED-NOT-HELD and its ribo arm is file-unverified.

H3_transcriptome_plus_proteome.trainable_today: SAME-FLASK PERTURBATION-PAIRED: essentially NO (n small). BASELINE/CROSS-STUDY: YES.
H3_transcriptome_plus_proteome.basis: Same-deposit P+L held = 2 (PXD056426, PXD020079); same-deposit T+P held = 0 (PXD023038 proteome held but its T not public/same-flask). Baseline H3 (CCLE proteome 375 lines / ProCan 949 lines) is fetchable and abundant, so H3 as a per-modality/baseline head is fine; H3 as a same-flask PERTURBATION-delta head across >1 line is not held.

H4_proteome_perturbation_plus_HLA_to_imm.trainable_today: THESIS VALIDATED on ONE line (HAP1/PXD056426); TRAINED-HEAD across >1 cell line/HLA: NO.
H4_proteome_perturbation_plus_HLA_to_imm.basis: H4 kill-gate PASSED on HAP1 (B2M-KO->2% presentation, proteome ~100%, rho=-0.51) — that is a mechanism validation on ONE cell line, ONE HLA background, using ONE same-flask P+L deposit. To train a GENERALIZING H4 head (leave-cell-line-out / leave-HLA-out / leave-KO-out beating B1) you need same-flask machinery-perturbation + matched proteome + immunopeptidome on MULTIPLE HLA backgrounds. Held today: only PXD056426 (HAP1) is same-flask P+L machinery-KO. All other held L deposits are L-only (must borrow P/T cross-study) or single perturbation classes. => H4 is validated, NOT trained beyond one line.

honest_headline.identified_not_held_paired_backlog: ~25-30 accessions incl. the 4-layer PXD013649 and the machinery-KO cluster
honest_headline.interpretation: The moat is SCARCE exactly as the docx §5 predicted. As a SAME-FLASK, HELD, trainable corpus it is 2 paired triples (both single-HLA-background), only one of which (PXD056426) carries the machinery-KO causal signal that H4 needs. The 'feasible, not just bootstrap' claim in the manifests is TRUE about EXISTENCE (accessions are real) but NOT about HOLDINGS (they are not landed) — training beyond one cell line is blocked on acquisition + generation, not on public existence for T/L, and on genuine white-space for R and for multi-HLA machinery-KO L.

immediate_zero_cost_acquisitions_that_wi: PXD020750 (GRANTA-519 IFN-g, single-deposit T+P+L, distinct HLA) — the highest-value fetch; gets H4 from 1 to 2 HLA backgrounds same-flask.
PXD023044 (complete P+L on the held PXD023038 TNBC proteome; MDA-MB-231 HLA) — 3rd HLA background.
PXD017407 + GSE144373 (4-line melanoma panel IFN-g + palbociclib, T+P+L) — +4 HLA-typed lines and a 2nd perturbation class.
MSV000091285 (ONX-0914 immunoproteasome-inhibitor + carfilzomib, HLA-I) — extends the machinery axis pharmacologically.

machinery-KO cluster PXD060575/060572/054494/014804/065279/078020/046825/013064 (ERAP1/ERAP2/B2M/TAPBP/TAPBPR KO on A375/C1R/HeLa/721.221) — multi-HLA replicates of the HAP1 causal signal; the direct leave-KO-out / leave-line-out training set for H4.
what_public_data_still_cannot_supply: SAME-FLASK Ribo-seq (H2) under perturbation on any HLA-typed line — genuine white space; H2 matched-modality requires generation.
SAME-FLASK 4-layer T+R+P+L on >1 HLA background — 0 held, PXD013649 is the only candidate and its ribo arm is file-unverified.
standalone NLRC5-KO, PSMB8/9/10 (immunoproteasome catalytic) KO, PSME1/2/3 (PA28) KO immunopeptidome — re-confirmed white space; the single highest-value dataset that DOES NOT EXIST publicly.

CRO_experiments_needed.spec: HLA-typed cell-line panel (>=6 lines spanning common supertypes: A*02:01, A*03:01, A*24:02, B*07:02, B*40:01, C*07) x machinery-perturbation panel (B2M, TAP1/2, TAPBP, ERAP1/2, PSMB8/9/10, NLRC5, CIITA KO + IFN-g/IFN-a/MEKi/CDK4-6i drug arms) x paired same-flask T (RNA-seq) + P (DIA proteome) + L (HLA-I & HLA-II immunopeptidome), matched WT/vehicle controls, >=3 reps.
CRO_experiments_needed.why: This is the ONLY way to get (a) same-flask cross-modal deltas the transformer needs, (b) >1 HLA background for leave-HLA-out generalization, (c) the immunoproteasome/NLRC5 KO ligandomes that do not exist anywhere, and (d) H2 (Ribo-seq) as a matched modality.
CRO_experiments_needed.minimum_to_move_H4_from_validated_to_tra: 6 HLA-typed lines x (B2M+TAP1+TAPBP+ERAP1+PSMB8 KO + WT) x paired P+L = 36 conditions; add IFN-g arm to double. This closes leave-line-out/leave-KO-out for H4 at ~72 same-flask paired units — the minimal generalizable atlas.

go_no_go.H4_thesis_kill_test: GO — already PASSED on public data (HAP1/PXD056426), reproducible.
go_no_go.H4_trained_head_beyond_one_line: NO-GO on HELD data today; conditional-GO after fetching PXD020750 + PXD023044 + PXD017407 + the KO cluster (public, zero wet-lab) which reaches ~4-7 HLA backgrounds same-flask; FULL-GO requires Tier-2 CRO for immunoproteasome/NLRC5 KO L + any matched Ribo-seq (H2).
go_no_go.H2_matched_head: NO-GO on public data (genuine white space) — Tier-2 generation required.
go_no_go.H3_baseline_head: GO (CCLE/ProCan proteome fetchable); H3 perturbation-delta across lines = same as H4 gap.

caveats: HELD vs IDENTIFIED is the load-bearing distinction: registries count VERIFIED accessions; S3 measurement 2026-09-13 counts landed bytes. The gap between '~25-30 paired studies exist' and '2 same-flask paired triples held' is entirely acquisition status, not fabrication.

PXD056426 and PXD020079 same-deposit P is asserted from in-deposit proteome .raw filenames ('Prot'/matched proteome) — proteome USABILITY (searched quant vs raw) still needs a DIA/immunopeptidomics search step for both.
Cross-study HLA-join triples (~8) are NOT same-flask and per docx §6 'unpaired data cannot train the cross-modal transformation' — they support pretraining/baselines only.

H2 ribo-seq acquisition self-reported LIMITED (upload failures); the ~14.8k-sample public corpus is real but unretrieved — H2 gap is holdings+matching, not existence, EXCEPT under perturbation on HLA-typed lines where it is genuine white space.
PXD013649 4-layer claim: accession real, ribo-seq-in-deposit at file level UNVERIFIED and NOT HELD — do not count as a trainable 4-layer set.
